scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run workspace:check && bun run unused && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run docs:build
scripts.dev:devtools-v4: bun run build && bun --cwd=test/fixtures/nuxt5-nightly install --ignore-scripts && bun --cwd=test/fixtures/nuxt5-nightly run dev
scripts.docs:deploy: bun run build && bun run docs:build && bun run --cwd=docs deploy
scripts.docs:preview: bun run build && bun run docs:build && bun run --cwd=docs preview
scripts.docs:typecheck: bun run build && bun run --cwd=docs typecheck
scripts.postinstall: bun run build && bun --cwd=docs run nuxt prepare
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter nuxt-files-sdk typecheck && bun run docs:typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json
